audit_status.source_base: Hebrew 2 Samuel chapter 22, first-pass poetic draft aligned later; compare Psalm 18
audit_status.review_note: Reviewed for royal victory-song genre, Divine-warrior imagery, cosmic storm language, Sheol/death metaphors, righteousness and blamelessness claims, violence training, enemy destruction, foreign submission, imperial rule, covenant language, and tension with David's documented abuses.

verses.restored: David spoke to YHWH words of this song on day YHWH rescued him from palm of all his enemies and from palm of Saul.

familiar.text: And David spake unto the LORD the words of this song in the day that the LORD had delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul:

modern.text: And David sang this song to the LORD on the day the LORD had delivered him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul.

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר דָּוִד֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה אֶת דִּבְרֵ֖י הַשִּׁירָ֣ה הַזֹּ֑את בְּיוֹם֩ הִצִּ֨יל יְהוָ֥ה אֹת֛וֹ מִכַּ֥ף כָּל אֹיְבָ֖יו וּמִכַּ֥ף שָׁאֽוּל

verses.restored: He said: YHWH is my rock-crag, my fortress, and my deliverer.

familiar.text: And he said, The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer;

modern.text: He said: “The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer.

original.text: וַיֹּאמַ֑ר יְהוָ֛ה סַֽלְעִ֥י וּמְצֻדָתִ֖י וּמְפַלְטִי לִֽי

verses.restored: Divine is my rock in whom I take refuge, my shield and horn of my rescue, my stronghold and refuge, my savior; from violence you save me.

familiar.text: The God of my rock; in him will I trust: he is my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge, my saviour; thou savest me from violence.

modern.text: My God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation. My stronghold, my refuge, and my Savior, You save me from violence.

original.text: אֱלֹהֵ֥י צוּרִ֖י אֶחֱסֶה בּ֑וֹ מָגִנִּ֞י וְקֶ֣רֶן יִשְׁעִ֗י מִשְׂגַּבִּי֙ וּמְנוּסִ֔י מֹשִׁעִ֕י מֵחָמָ֖ס תֹּשִׁעֵֽנִי

verses.restored: I call upon YHWH, worthy of praise, and I am rescued from my enemies.

familiar.text: I will call on the LORD, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.

modern.text: I will call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; so shall I be saved from my enemies.

original.text: מְהֻלָּ֖ל אֶקְרָ֣א יְהוָ֑ה וּמֵאֹיְבַ֖י אִוָּשֵֽׁעַ

verses.restored: For waves of death surrounded me; torrents of destruction/Belial terrified me.

familiar.text: When the waves of death compassed me, the floods of ungodly men made me afraid;

modern.text: For the waves of death engulfed me; the torrents of chaos overwhelmed me.

original.text: כִּ֥י אֲפָפֻ֖נִי מִשְׁבְּרֵי מָ֑וֶת נַחֲלֵ֥י בְלִיַּ֖עַל יְבַעֲתֻֽנִי

verses.restored: Cords of Sheol surrounded me; snares of death confronted me.

familiar.text: The sorrows of hell compassed me about; the snares of death prevented me;

modern.text: The cords of Sheol entangled me; the snares of death confronted me.

original.text: חֶבְלֵ֥י שְׁא֖וֹל סַבֻּ֑נִי קִדְּמֻ֖נִי מֹֽקְשֵׁי מָֽוֶת

verses.restored: In my distress I called upon YHWH; to my Divine I called. From temple YHWH heard my voice, and my cry entered YHWH's ears.

familiar.text: In my distress I called upon the LORD, and cried to my God: and he did hear my voice out of his temple, and my cry did enter into his ears.

modern.text: In my distress I called upon the LORD; I cried out to my God. And from His temple He heard my voice, and my cry for help reached His ears.

original.text: בַּצַּר לִי֙ אֶקְרָ֣א יְהוָ֔ה וְאֶל אֱלֹהַ֖י אֶקְרָ֑א וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע מֵהֵֽיכָלוֹ֙ קוֹלִ֔י וְשַׁוְעָתִ֖י בְּאָזְנָֽיו

verses.restored: Then earth shook and quaked; foundations of heavens trembled and shook because YHWH was angry.

familiar.text: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations of heaven moved and shook, because he was wroth.

modern.text: Then the earth shook and quaked; the foundations of the heavens trembled; they were shaken because He burned with anger.

original.text: ותגעש וַתִּרְעַשׁ֙ הָאָ֔רֶץ מוֹסְד֥וֹת הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם יִרְגָּ֑זוּ וַיִּֽתְגָּעֲשׁ֖וּ כִּֽי חָ֥רָה לֽוֹ

verses.restored: Smoke rose from YHWH's nostrils, and fire from YHWH's mouth devoured; coals burned from it.

familiar.text: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.

modern.text: Smoke rose from His nostrils, and consuming fire came from His mouth; glowing coals blazed forth.

original.text: עָלָ֤ה עָשָׁן֙ בְּאַפּ֔וֹ וְאֵ֥שׁ מִפִּ֖יו תֹּאכֵ֑ל גֶּחָלִ֖ים בָּעֲר֥וּ מִמֶּֽנּוּ

verses.restored: YHWH bowed heavens and came down, with thick darkness beneath YHWH's feet.

familiar.text: He bowed the heavens also, and came down; and darkness was under his feet.

modern.text: He parted the heavens and came down with dark clouds beneath His feet.

original.text: וַיֵּ֥ט שָׁמַ֖יִם וַיֵּרַ֑ד וַעֲרָפֶ֖ל תַּ֥חַת רַגְלָֽיו

verses.restored: YHWH rode upon a cherub and flew, appearing upon wings of wind.

familiar.text: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: and he was seen upon the wings of the wind.

modern.text: He mounted a cherub and flew; He soared on the wings of the wind.

original.text: וַיִּרְכַּ֥ב עַל כְּר֖וּב וַיָּעֹ֑ף וַיֵּרָ֖א עַל כַּנְפֵי רֽוּחַ

verses.restored: YHWH made darkness around as shelter: gatherings of waters, thick clouds of skies.

familiar.text: And he made darkness pavilions round about him, dark waters, and thick clouds of the skies.

modern.text: He made darkness a canopy around Him, a gathering of water and thick clouds.

original.text: וַיָּ֥שֶׁת חֹ֛שֶׁךְ סְבִיבֹתָ֖יו סֻכּ֑וֹת חַֽשְׁרַת מַ֖יִם עָבֵ֥י שְׁחָקִֽים

verses.restored: From brightness before YHWH, coals of fire burned.

familiar.text: Through the brightness before him were coals of fire kindled.

modern.text: From the brightness of His presence coals of fire blazed forth.

original.text: מִנֹּ֖גַהּ נֶגְדּ֑וֹ בָּעֲר֖וּ גַּחֲלֵי אֵֽשׁ

verses.restored: YHWH thundered from heavens; Most High gave voice.

familiar.text: The LORD thundered from heaven, and the most High uttered his voice.

modern.text: The LORD thundered from heaven; the voice of the Most High resounded.

original.text: יַרְעֵ֥ם מִן שָׁמַ֖יִם יְהוָ֑ה וְעֶלְי֖וֹן יִתֵּ֥ן קוֹלֽוֹ

verses.restored: YHWH sent arrows and scattered them, lightning and threw them into confusion.

familiar.text: And he sent out arrows, and scattered them; lightning, and discomfited them.

modern.text: He shot His arrows and scattered the foes; He hurled lightning and routed them.

original.text: וַיִּשְׁלַ֥ח חִצִּ֖ים וַיְפִיצֵ֑ם בָּרָ֖ק ויהמם

verses.restored: Channels of sea appeared; foundations of world were uncovered at rebuke of YHWH, from breath of wind of YHWH's nostrils.

familiar.text: And the channels of the sea appeared, the foundations of the world were discovered, at the rebuking of the LORD, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.

modern.text: The channels of the sea appeared, and the foundations of the world were exposed at the rebuke of the LORD, at the blast of the breath of His nostrils.

original.text: וַיֵּֽרָאוּ֙ אֲפִ֣קֵי יָ֔ם יִגָּל֖וּ מֹסְד֣וֹת תֵּבֵ֑ל בְּגַעֲרַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה מִנִּשְׁמַ֖ת ר֥וּחַ אַפּֽוֹ

verses.restored: YHWH sent from height and took me, drawing me from many waters.

familiar.text: He sent from above, he took me; he drew me out of many waters;

modern.text: He reached down from on high and took hold of me; He drew me out of deep waters.

original.text: יִשְׁלַ֥ח מִמָּר֖וֹם יִקָּחֵ֑נִי יַֽמְשֵׁ֖נִי מִמַּ֥יִם רַבִּֽים

verses.restored: YHWH rescued me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me, because they were stronger than I.

familiar.text: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them that hated me: for they were too strong for me.

modern.text: He rescued me from my powerful enemy, from foes too mighty for me.

original.text: יַצִּילֵ֕נִי מֵאֹיְבִ֖י עָ֑ז מִשֹּׂ֣נְאַ֔י כִּ֥י אָמְצ֖וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי

verses.restored: They confronted me in day of my calamity, but YHWH was my support.

familiar.text: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the LORD was my stay.

modern.text: They confronted me in my day of calamity, but the LORD was my support.

original.text: יְקַדְּמֻ֖נִי בְּי֣וֹם אֵידִ֑י וַיְהִ֧י יְהוָ֛ה מִשְׁעָ֖ן לִֽי

verses.restored: YHWH brought me out to a broad place; YHWH rescued me because YHWH delighted in me.

familiar.text: He brought me forth also into a large place: he delivered me, because he delighted in me.

modern.text: He brought me out into the open; He rescued me because He delighted in me.

original.text: וַיֹּצֵ֥א לַמֶּרְחָ֖ב אֹתִ֑י יְחַלְּצֵ֖נִי כִּי חָ֥פֵֽץ בִּֽי

verses.restored: YHWH dealt with me according to my righteousness; according to cleanness of my hands YHWH returned to me.

familiar.text: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness: according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.

modern.text: The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness; He has repaid me according to the cleanness of my hands.

original.text: יִגְמְלֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֖ה כְּצִדְקָתִ֑י כְּבֹ֥ר יָדַ֖י יָשִׁ֥יב לִֽי

verses.restored: For I kept ways of YHWH and did not wickedly turn from my Divine.

familiar.text: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

modern.text: For I have kept the ways of the LORD and have not wickedly departed from my God.

original.text: כִּ֥י שָׁמַ֖רְתִּי דַּרְכֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְלֹ֥א רָשַׁ֖עְתִּי מֵאֱלֹהָֽי

verses.restored: For all YHWH's judgments were before me, and statutes I did not turn from.

familiar.text: For all his judgments were before me: and as for his statutes, I did not depart from them.

modern.text: For all His ordinances are before me; I have not disregarded His statutes.

original.text: כִּ֥י כָל משפטו לְנֶגְדִּ֑י וְחֻקֹּתָ֖יו לֹא אָס֥וּר מִמֶּֽנָּה

verses.restored: I was whole/blameless toward YHWH and guarded myself from my iniquity.

familiar.text: I was also upright before him, and have kept myself from mine iniquity.

modern.text: And I have been blameless before Him and kept myself from iniquity.

original.text: וָאֶהְיֶ֥ה תָמִ֖ים ל֑וֹ וָאֶשְׁתַּמְּרָ֖ה מֵעֲוֺנִֽי

verses.restored: YHWH returned to me according to my righteousness, according to my cleanness before YHWH's eyes.

familiar.text: Therefore the LORD hath recompensed me according to my righteousness; according to my cleanness in his eye sight.

modern.text: So the LORD has repaid me according to my righteousness, according to my cleanness in His sight.

original.text: וַיָּ֧שֶׁב יְהוָ֛ה לִ֖י כְּצִדְקָתִ֑י כְּבֹרִ֖י לְנֶ֥גֶד עֵינָֽיו

verses.restored: With one of covenant-loyalty you show covenant-loyalty; with a whole/blameless warrior you show yourself whole.

familiar.text: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful, and with the upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright.

modern.text: To the faithful You show Yourself faithful, to the blameless You show Yourself blameless;

original.text: עִם חָסִ֖יד תִּתְחַסָּ֑ד עִם גִּבּ֥וֹר תָּמִ֖ים תִּתַּמָּֽם

verses.restored: With one purified you show yourself pure; with one twisted you show yourself astute/contending.

familiar.text: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself unsavoury.

modern.text: to the pure You show Yourself pure, but to the crooked You show Yourself shrewd.

original.text: עִם נָבָ֖ר תִּתָּבָ֑ר וְעִם עִקֵּ֖שׁ תִּתַּפָּֽל

verses.restored: You rescue afflicted people, but your eyes are against haughty ones; you bring them low.

familiar.text: And the afflicted people thou wilt save: but thine eyes are upon the haughty, that thou mayest bring them down.

modern.text: You save an afflicted people, but Your eyes are on the haughty to bring them down.

original.text: וְאֶת עַ֥ם עָנִ֖י תּוֹשִׁ֑יעַ וְעֵינֶ֖יךָ עַל רָמִ֥ים תַּשְׁפִּֽיל

verses.restored: For you are my lamp, YHWH; YHWH illuminates my darkness.

familiar.text: For thou art my lamp, O LORD: and the LORD will lighten my darkness.

modern.text: For You, O LORD, are my lamp; the LORD lights up my darkness.

original.text: כִּֽי אַתָּ֥ה נֵירִ֖י יְהוָ֑ה וַיהוָ֖ה יַגִּ֥יהַּ חָשְׁכִּֽי

verses.restored: For by you I run against a troop; by my Divine I leap over a wall.

familiar.text: For by thee I have run through a troop: by my God have I leaped over a wall.

modern.text: For in You I can charge an army; with my God I can scale a wall.

original.text: כִּ֥י בְכָ֖ה אָר֣וּץ גְּד֑וּד בֵּאלֹהַ֖י אֲדַלֶּג שֽׁוּר

verses.restored: As for Divine, the way is complete; word of YHWH is refined. YHWH is a shield to all who take refuge.

familiar.text: As for God, his way is perfect; the word of the LORD is tried: he is a buckler to all them that trust in him.

modern.text: As for God, His way is perfect; the word of the LORD is flawless. He is a shield to all who take refuge in Him.

original.text: הָאֵ֖ל תָּמִ֣ים דַּרְכּ֑וֹ אִמְרַ֤ת יְהוָה֙ צְרוּפָ֔ה מָגֵ֣ן ה֔וּא לְכֹ֖ל הַחֹסִ֥ים בּֽוֹ

verses.restored: For who is Divine except YHWH, and who is a rock except our Divine?

familiar.text: For who is God, save the LORD? and who is a rock, save our God?

modern.text: For who is God besides the LORD? And who is the Rock except our God?

original.text: כִּ֥י מִי אֵ֖ל מִבַּלְעֲדֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וּמִ֥י צ֖וּר מִֽבַּלְעֲדֵ֥י אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ

verses.restored: Divine is my strong refuge and makes my way complete.

familiar.text: God is my strength and power: and he maketh my way perfect.

modern.text: God is my strong fortress and He makes my way clear.

original.text: הָאֵ֥ל מָעוּזִּ֖י חָ֑יִל וַיַּתֵּ֥ר תָּמִ֖ים דרכו

verses.restored: YHWH makes my feet like deer and causes me to stand upon my high places.

familiar.text: He maketh my feet like hinds’ feet: and setteth me upon my high places.

modern.text: He makes my feet like those of a deer and stations me upon the heights.

original.text: מְשַׁוֶּ֥ה רגליו כָּאַיָּל֑וֹת וְעַ֥ל בָּמוֹתַ֖י יַעֲמִדֵֽנִי

verses.restored: YHWH trains my hands for battle, so my arms bend a bow of bronze.

familiar.text: He teacheth my hands to war; so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.

modern.text: He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.

original.text: מְלַמֵּ֥ד יָדַ֖י לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה וְנִחַ֥ת קֶֽשֶׁת נְחוּשָׁ֖ה זְרֹעֹתָֽי

verses.restored: You gave me shield of your rescue, and your answering/gentleness made me great.

familiar.text: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy gentleness hath made me great.

modern.text: You have given me Your shield of salvation, and Your gentleness exalts me.

original.text: וַתִּתֶּן לִ֖י מָגֵ֣ן יִשְׁעֶ֑ךָ וַעֲנֹתְךָ֖ תַּרְבֵּֽנִי

verses.restored: You broadened my step beneath me, and my ankles did not slip.

familiar.text: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me; so that my feet did not slip.

modern.text: You broaden the path beneath me so that my ankles do not give way.

original.text: תַּרְחִ֥יב צַעֲדִ֖י תַּחְתֵּ֑נִי וְלֹ֥א מָעֲד֖וּ קַרְסֻלָּֽי

verses.restored: I pursued my enemies and destroyed them; I did not return until I consumed them.

familiar.text: I have pursued mine enemies, and destroyed them; and turned not again until I had consumed them.

modern.text: I pursued my enemies and destroyed them; I did not turn back until they were consumed.

original.text: אֶרְדְּפָ֥ה אֹיְבַ֖י וָאַשְׁמִידֵ֑ם וְלֹ֥א אָשׁ֖וּב עַד כַּלּוֹתָֽם

verses.restored: I consumed them and crushed them so they did not rise; they fell beneath my feet.

familiar.text: And I have consumed them, and wounded them, that they could not arise: yea, they are fallen under my feet.

modern.text: I devoured and crushed them so they could not rise; they have fallen under my feet.

original.text: וָאֲכַלֵּ֥ם וָאֶמְחָצֵ֖ם וְלֹ֣א יְקוּמ֑וּן וַֽיִּפְּל֖וּ תַּ֥חַת רַגְלָֽי

verses.restored: You girded me with strength for battle; you caused those rising against me to bow beneath me.

familiar.text: For thou hast girded me with strength to battle: them that rose up against me hast thou subdued under me.

modern.text: You have armed me with strength for battle; You have subdued my foes beneath me.

original.text: וַתַּזְרֵ֥נִי חַ֖יִל לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה תַּכְרִ֥יעַ קָמַ֖י תַּחְתֵּֽנִי

verses.restored: You gave me backs/necks of my enemies, and those hating me I destroyed.

familiar.text: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies, that I might destroy them that hate me.

modern.text: You have made my enemies retreat before me; I put an end to those who hated me.

original.text: וְאֹ֣יְבַ֔י תַּ֥תָּה לִּ֖י עֹ֑רֶף מְשַׂנְאַ֖י וָאַצְמִיתֵֽם

verses.restored: They looked about, but there was no savior; to YHWH, but YHWH did not answer them.

familiar.text: They looked, but there was none to save; even unto the LORD, but he answered them not.

modern.text: They looked, but there was no one to save them— to the LORD, but He did not answer.

original.text: יִשְׁע֖וּ וְאֵ֣ין מֹשִׁ֑יעַ אֶל יְהוָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א עָנָֽם

verses.restored: I ground them like dust of earth; like mud of streets I crushed and stamped them.

familiar.text: Then did I beat them as small as the dust of the earth, I did stamp them as the mire of the street, and did spread them abroad.

modern.text: I ground them as the dust of the earth; I crushed and trampled them like mud in the streets.

translation_notes: This is a royal victory song and theological self-portrait, not a neutral biography. Its claims of clean hands and blameless conduct stand in sharp tension with Bathsheba, Uriah, Joab's impunity, the concubines, imperial executions, and other harms narrated around it.

The cosmic descent, smoke, fire, thunder, sea exposure, arrows, and lightning are ancient storm-theophany poetry. They are not scientific description or permission to attribute disasters to Divine rage.
Death, Sheol, waves, and snares describe extremity and rescue; they should not be used to shame fear, trauma, depression, or suicidal crisis.
Verses 21-25 can express a particular experience of deliverance without establishing that safety proves righteousness or suffering proves guilt.
'Blameless' and 'clean hands' must not become leader immunity, denial of survivor testimony, or a doctrine that an anointed ruler cannot abuse.

Training hands for war, pursuing, consuming, grinding, and trampling enemies are violent royal imagery. They may not be recruited into modern holy war, vigilantism, militarized masculinity, or spiritual warfare against human beings.
Verse 42 portrays enemies receiving no answer. Divine silence cannot be inferred from defeat, ethnicity, political opposition, illness, or unanswered prayer.
Foreign submission and rule over unknown peoples reflect imperial ideology. Cringing subjects are not evidence of benevolent governance.

The covenant ending belongs within Jewish scripture. It may not justify hereditary autocracy, Christian supersessionism, modern territorial entitlement, or exemption of Davidic leaders from accountability.
safety_note: Read this song beside the narrative record, especially the people harmed by David's power. Do not turn poetic claims of righteousness into factual acquittal, violent imagery into present-day instruction, or national victory into proof that Divine values one people above another. Refuge in YHWH must remain compatible with truth, survivor testimony, and accountability.
